column1: # derivation: §5.1: BIN_DIV on integers truncates toward zero: 7 / 2 = 3,
# (-0.2 truncated; flooring would give -1). §5.3: a zero divisor answers
# NULL for that row (ids 5, 6, 7). §5.0: a NULL operand gives NULL, checked
# before the divisor, so NULL / 0 (id 8) is NULL by §5.0, and so is a NULL
# b (id 10). Types: the integer type, INT64 (§5.1, §8.10),
